notes_for_human: Verification mission: CONFIRMED. The unsourced sentence 'Expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028' matches the live SDE Chicago posting verbatim (in-posting it reads lowercase, mid-sentence: 'expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028') at https://www.drw.com/work-at-drw/listings/software-developer-intern-3467328, cross-checked on Greenhouse drweng/jobs/7992936. Compensation: the $225k figure is real and posted -- exact sentence captured above; oddly DRW words it as a 'range' of a single number. QTA Chicago posts $250,000. Sponsorship: DRW posting bodies carry NO sponsorship eligibility statement; the only work-auth language is the two standard Greenhouse application questions quoted above (US work authorization yes/no and future-H-1B-sponsorship yes/no) -- these are screening questions, not stated criteria, so treat sponsorship policy as effectively unstated. Cooling-off: DRW publishes nothing -- /work-at-drw/interns read in full, no FAQ section exists, and no careers FAQ page was found on the drw.com domain. Interview process is described on /work-at-drw/interns as four steps (application, technical challenge, Zoom interview, final-round visit) but I only obtained a paraphrase, not copyable verbatim text, hence the empty process quotes per rules. Aggregator claims from search snippets (e.g. '$96.13/hr + $25,000 signing bonus', 'Dec 2026-Aug 2027 window') were NOT used -- they reflect the prior cycle or tier-3 sources.
